dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: The healthier you are, the better you can work, right?

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: I'm a doctor. If you have any minor ailments or injuries, I'm your man. As for major ailments and injuries... I'll do what I can, but I'm not making any promises.

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: If you're fatigued from work, you can rest in the infirmary. You can't hear the loudspeaker there, which is good for your mental health.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the secret to staying healthy...

dialogues.speaker: Arderne
dialogues.text: Early to bed, early to rise. Eat healthy foods. Moderate exercise. Take care of your mental state and stay in good spirits. It's a shame that the Fortress of Meropide doesn't get much sunshine...
